resources.string: From Google Keep, Standard Notes, Joplin, Notesnook or Markdown files
Bring in notes from another app. Choose its export and Encly recognises the format itself. Everything stays on this phone; nothing is uploaded.
Google Takeout .zip (choose it as it is, no need to unzip) or loose .json notes
In Google Takeout select only Keep, create the export and download the .zip. Then choose that .zip here.
Pinned and archived state, colours and attachments. Only the first label becomes the tag.
Decrypted backup (.txt or .json), or the .zip of a decrypted download
In Standard Notes download a decrypted backup, not an encrypted one. Then choose the file or the .zip here.
Encrypted backups are refused. Pinned and archived state, files and other item types. Only the first tag is kept.
JEX archive (.jex), RAW folder or Markdown export
In Joplin choose File → Export all and pick JEX or RAW. Then choose the file or folder here.
Attachments, and to-do status (to-dos arrive as ordinary notes). A note gets its first tag, otherwise its notebook name.
Markdown, Markdown with front matter or TXT export (.zip)
In Notesnook export your notes as Markdown with front matter to keep dates and tags. Then choose the .zip here. Encrypted backups cannot be imported.
Attachments, pinned and archived state, colours. The first tag, otherwise the notebook, becomes the tag.
.md and .txt files or a whole folder, for example from Obsidian or Markor
Choose the files, or the folder that holds them. The file name is the title; simple front matter (title, tags, dates) is read.
Images, attachments, plugins and formatting beyond headings, lists, checklists and quotes. The first folder becomes the tag.
The ticked notes are added to this vault. Nothing is replaced, and anything already here is skipped.
